KERFINATOR
Down with Deutsch.
==================================================================

TO PLAY
  1. Open KERFINATOR.html (double-click it). Use Edge or Chrome.
  2. The first time, the games copy themselves to the computer.
     A bar at the top shows progress. This happens only once.
  3. Click a game. It opens in its own tab.
     Click inside the game once to start sound. F11 = fullscreen.

TO PLAY WITHOUT THE USB DRIVE
  Click "Save to this computer" (red bar at the top, or Settings)
  and save KERFINATOR.html to your Desktop. Next time, open that
  one. Your games and progress are already on the computer.

TO ADD YOUR OWN GAMES
  Click Import and drop in a game folder, a .zip file or an .html
  file. Only browser (HTML5) games work.

KEEP YOUR PROGRESS SAFE
  Settings > Export backup saves your progress to a file.
  Restore it on any computer with Settings > Restore a backup.
  Clearing the browser's data, or a private/InPrivate window,
  erases KERFINATOR's games and progress on that computer.

GOOD TO KNOW
  - Nothing is installed. No admin rights. No internet needed.
  - Edge and Chrome keep separate libraries, and so does each
    Windows account.
  - Online extras (accounts, leaderboards, ads) don't work offline.
    The games themselves do.
  - More help: Settings > Help.

------------------------------------------------------------------
PUTTING GAMES ON THE USB DRIVE (for whoever sets up the drive)
  1. Put each game in its own folder inside the "games" folder,
     e.g.  games\Retro Bowl\index.html
     (Optional: a cover.png or cover.jpg next to it becomes its cover.)
  2. Open KERFINATOR.html > Settings > Prepare a USB drive >
     Build USB library, and choose this KERFINATOR folder.
     Allow editing when the browser asks.
  3. Do step 2 again whenever you add, change or remove games.
  Keep KERFINATOR in a folder on the drive, not on the drive's root.
